queries.query:
// Query for Azimuth Position
azimuthPosition = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "lsst.sal.MTMount.azimuth" and r["_field"] == "actualPosition")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    axis: "Azimuth",
    time: r._time,
    position: r._value
  }))

// Query for Azimuth Motion State
azimuthMotionState = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "lsst.sal.MTMount.logevent_azimuthMotionState" and r["_field"] == "state")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    axis: "Azimuth",
    motionState:
      if r._value == 0 then "STOPPING"
      else if r._value == 1 then "STOPPED"
      else if r._value == 2 then "MOVING_POINT_TO_POINT"
      else if r._value == 3 then "JOGGING"
      else if r._value == 4 then "TRACKING"
      else if r._value == 5 then "TRACKING_PAUSED"
      else "UNKNOWN"
  }))

// Query for Elevation Position
elevationPosition = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "lsst.sal.MTMount.elevation" and r["_field"] == "actualPosition")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    axis: "Elevation",
    time: r._time,
    position: r._value
  }))

// Query for Elevation Motion State
elevationMotionState = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "lsst.sal.MTMount.logevent_elevationMotionState" and r["_field"] == "state")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    axis: "Elevation",
    motionState:
      if r._value == 0 then "STOPPING"
      else if r._value == 1 then "STOPPED"
      else if r._value == 2 then "MOVING_POINT_TO_POINT"
      else if r._value == 3 then "JOGGING"
      else if r._value == 4 then "TRACKING"
      else if r._value == 5 then "TRACKING_PAUSED"
      else "UNKNOWN"
  }))

// Combine Position and Motion State Queries
azimuthData = join(
  tables: {pos: azimuthPosition, state: azimuthMotionState},
  on: ["axis"]
)

elevationData = join(
  tables: {pos: elevationPosition, state: elevationMotionState},
  on: ["axis"]
)

// Combine Both Axes Data into a Single Table
union(tables: [azimuthData, elevationData])
  |> keep(columns: ["axis", "time", "position", "motionState"]) // Keep relevant columns

cells.note: All queries on this dashboard retrieve data from the past 1 day (1d). Adjusting the dashboard's time range will not affect the queries, but you can change the refresh interval to control how frequently the data is updated.

queries.query:
import "math"

// Enable State Query
enableState = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "lsst.sal.MTMount.logevent_cameraCableWrapFollowing" and r["_field"] == "enabled")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    wrap: "Camera Cable Wrap",
    enableState: if r._value == 1 then "ENABLED" else "DISABLED"
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["wrap", "enableState"])

// Motion State Query
motionState = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "lsst.sal.MTMount.logevent_cameraCableWrapMotionState" and r["_field"] == "state")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    wrap: "Camera Cable Wrap",
    motionState: 
      if r._value == 0 then "STOPPING"
      else if r._value == 1 then "STOPPED"
      else if r._value == 2 then "MOVING_POINT_TO_POINT"
      else if r._value == 3 then "JOGGING"
      else if r._value == 4 then "TRACKING"
      else if r._value == 5 then "TRACKING_PAUSED"
      else "UNKNOWN"
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["wrap", "motionState"])

// Position Query with 2 Decimal Places Formatting
positionState = from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "lsst.sal.MTMount.cameraCableWrap" and r["_field"] == "actualPosition")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    wrap: "Camera Cable Wrap",
    position: string(v: math.round(x: r._value * 100.0) / 100.0) // Round to 2 decimal places
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["wrap", "position"])

// Join Enable State and Motion State
wrapState = join(
  tables: {enable: enableState, motion: motionState},
  on: ["wrap"]
)

// Join with Position
wrapFullState = join(
  tables: {state: wrapState, position: positionState},
  on: ["wrap"]
)

// Final Result
wrapFullState
  |> keep(columns: ["wrap", "enableState", "motionState", "position"])

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "lsst.sal.MTM1M3.logevent_detailedState" and r["_field"] == "detailedState")
  |> last() // Fetch the most recent detailedState
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    detailedState: 
      if r._value == 1.00 then "DISABLED"
      else if r._value == 2.00 then "FAULT"
      else if r._value == 3.00 then "OFFLINE"
      else if r._value == 4.00 then "STANDBY"
      else if r._value == 5.00 then "PARKED"

      else if r._value == 10.00 then "RAISINGENGINEERING"
      else if r._value == 11.00 then "ACTIVEENGINEERING"
      else if r._value == 12.00 then "LOWERINGENGINEERING"

      else if r._value == 17.00 then "PAUSEDLOWERING"
      else if r._value == 18.00 then "PAUSEDLOWERINGENGINEERING"

      else if r._value == 6.00 then "RAISING"
      else if r._value == 7.00 then "ACTIVE"
      else if r._value == 8.00 then "LOWERING"
      else if r._value == 9.00 then "PARKEDENGINEERING"
      else if r._value == 10.00 then "RAISINGENGINEERING"
      else if r._value == 11.00 then "ACTIVEENGINEERING"
      else if r._value == 12.00 then "LOWERINGENGINEERING"
      else if r._value == 13.00 then "LOWERINGFAULT"
      else if r._value == 14.00 then "PROFILEHARDPOINTCORRECTIONS"
      else if r._value == 15.00 then "PAUSEDRAISING"
      else if r._value == 16.00 then "PAUSEDRAISINGENGINEERING"
      else if r._value == 17.00 then "PAUSEDLOWERING"
      else if r._value == 18.00 then "PAUSEDLOWERINGENGINEERING"
      else "UNKNOWN"
    }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "detailedState"]) // Retain both time and state
